name: Cream Cheese Cheddar Boule
short_description: Our bestseller: soft and light, with Australian cream cheese and cheddar.
description:
Baked with Japanese flour for a soft, light crumb and a fairer crust, with Australian premium cream cheese and cheddar. Easy to slice and serve on its own.

Every loaf takes more than 24 hours from scratch.

name: Cranberry Pumpkin Seed Country
short_description: Country sourdough with French flour, cranberries and pumpkin seeds.
description: A country-style sourdough made with French flour, laced with cranberries and pumpkin seeds: full-bodied, with a crunchy bite and a soft, spongy chew.

name: Home Milled Wheat Country
short_description: A classic loaf from wheat we mill ourselves on our stone miller.
description: We mill the wheat into flour on our own stone miller for a classic loaf that tastes naturally wholesome.

name: Blueberry Raisin Cream Cheese Rye
short_description: An original Baking Trip loaf with rye flour; good on its own.
description: Country-style with rye flour, blueberries, raisins and cream cheese. Slice and serve: no butter or jam needed.
